# Trichology Academy

> Clinical trichology education, consultations, and scalp health guidance from Lorraine Hawkins for UK hair professionals and clients.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://trichologyacademy.com/) - Main overview of Lorraine Hawkins, education, consultations, and featured resources.
- [About Lorraine Hawkins](https://trichologyacademy.com/about) - Background, credentials, and approach.
- [Services](https://trichologyacademy.com/services) - Clinical consultations, scalp assessments, and salon training.
- [Contact](https://trichologyacademy.com/contact) - Consultation and training enquiries.

## Education

- [Education Hub](https://trichologyacademy.com/education) - Main training hub for courses, workshops, and professional development.
- [Video Courses](https://trichologyacademy.com/education/videos) - Condition-specific video training for hair professionals.
- [Workshops](https://trichologyacademy.com/education/workshops) - In-person workshop catalogue.
- [Condition Library](https://trichologyacademy.com/education/conditions) - Reference guides to common hair and scalp conditions.

## Knowledge hub

- [Knowledge Hub](https://trichologyacademy.com/blog) - Evidence-based articles on scalp health, hair loss, and consultations.

## Optional

- [Shop](https://trichologyacademy.com/shop) - Scalp care and supporting products.
